note: Lane fno_exec: fno_execute.py's confirm path as POST /fno/execute reaches it (the route is the fno desk's; the refusals after the route's own checks are fno_execute.execute_entry/_validate's). The bed's fo_plan rows are F3 ENTRY plans in LAPSED / REJECTED_STRUCTURE, so every confirm must be refused NOT_ISSUED with the plan's status named, nothing written, and the replay Kite's order/GTT log EMPTY. A missing or false confirm and an unknown plan are refused before any read. No exit plan exists on the bed, so the click path (execute_click_exit) and the monitor's sends are graded by the Rust tests, not here. Added by review: confirm spellings Python refuses (True, 1, 'true '), empty/missing/quoting plan ids, a REJECTED_COST entry, the refusal at pre_open/after_close and on a re-post, a JSON body, and GET.

cases.name: fno_exec: a LAPSED F3 entry is refused NOT_ISSUED, nothing sent
fno_exec: a REJECTED_STRUCTURE F3 entry is refused NOT_ISSUED, nothing sent
fno_exec: confirm=false is CONFIRM_REQUIRED before any read
fno_exec: a missing confirm is the same refusal
fno_exec: an unknown plan is UNKNOWN_PLAN
fno_exec: another user's plan id is unknown to this user (FO7.6)
fno_exec: confirm=True (not the literal true) is CONFIRM_REQUIRED
fno_exec: confirm with a trailing space is CONFIRM_REQUIRED
fno_exec: an empty plan id is UNKNOWN_PLAN
fno_exec: a missing plan id is UNKNOWN_PLAN
fno_exec: a quoting plan id is UNKNOWN_PLAN (bound, never spliced)
fno_exec: a REJECTED_COST F3 entry is refused NOT_ISSUED
fno_exec: the same refusal before the open
fno_exec: the same refusal after the close
fno_exec: a second post of the same refused plan is refused the same way
fno_exec: a JSON body carries no form fields: CONFIRM_REQUIRED
